parameters.content:
T-047 · Typed input: canal, destino, HTML texto, botones [{text, callback_data}]; optional editarMessageId/replyTo/nombre/sinCopia (sinCopia is boolean, default false). One output: {ok, canal, messageId, wamid, copiaOk}. Call mode=each and wait. Telegram: Switch 0/2/3/4/6 with fixed native keyboards (three rows for 3; pairs for 2/4/6); other counts → Botones inválidos, HTML without attribution. WhatsApp: sequential queue (4096 text / 1024 interactive), then full group copy without buttons. Each WA failure marks the copy; a TG failure attempts a fixed group alert. T-052: ok reflects only the main channel. copiaOk reports the WA copy result (true/false; null for Telegram or sinCopia). sinCopia suppresses all group output, including context-error alerts. messageId is the first complete copy (or edited message); null without a copy or after copy failure, never the alert. T-049: media pending. More than 10 WA options are not silently truncated: mark failure and copy all options to the group. Network retries may duplicate delivery if the provider accepted a request but its response was lost.

T-048: wa_contexto (wamid, datos string) and wa_candados (clave, ejecucion string). Sequentially persist all successful wamids with or without a copy; tgMessageId only after a successful full copy; plain text <=1000 and buttons only from the message offering them. A persistence failure sends a one-line alert and preserves the delivery result. Daily cleanup at 03:15 America/Bogota: createdAt < now−7 days / now−1 day. Do not create system or extra columns. Configure both Data Table placeholders and publish this subworkflow to enable its schedule.
